1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 500 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from the group consisting of zirconium, aluminum, and iron compounds__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyalkylenimine selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein the amount of said crosslinker is sufficient to form a stable gel with the polyelectrolyte complex__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein the concentration of said cations is effective to enhance the stability of the nanoparticle in aqueous solutions__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, and is stable in aqueous solutions__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __further comprising a multivalent cation that is complexed within the nanoparticle__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron, or aluminum ions__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with the polyelectrolyte complex; and c) a fluid__.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein the polymer is partially hydrolyzed to enhance its crosslinking ability__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where __the fluid is selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, and other aqueous solutions__.
